issue_context.title: Bug: App crash when switching to another tab while items are selected
issue_context.body:
### Description

The app crashes if you selected a file and switched to another tab while the files are currently selected.

Works fine if you don't select anything before you switch tabs

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open 2 or more tabs
2. Select a file
3. Switch to another tab

### Requirements

- Fix the crash

### Files Version

2.4.51.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22624.1391

### Log file

```

	System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
   at Files.App.Actions.Content.ImageEdition.RotateLeftAction.Context_PropertyChanged(Object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
   ```

review_comments: What's the difference between ShellPage and SlimContentPage?

`ShellPage` is `Modern` or `Column`, `SlimeContentPage` refers to the layout in use
~I think they are not synced and so one is updated while the other is not and remains null.~
It may be that when you first open a new pane/tab SlimContentPage is null because it needs to load

I had found this bug while working on #11673 and I had fixed it there too.
If you can't reproduce it with tabs, try opening a new pane and it should crash
Thanks! We really need to move away from this concept but that's not your fault.
